Definition: {to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)}
BiblicalUsage: Yeda is the Aramaic word for knowing, for making known what was hidden. Nebuchadnezzar demanded the Chaldeans make known his dream and its interpretation, and the letter to the king says, be it known unto the king, that the Jews are rebuilding the city.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God makes known what kings cannot know, and the dream that was gone from Nebuchadnezzar was known to Daniel.
